rows.text: My nurse is not very tired.
What do they tell my family?
What do you tell my nurse?
I need my computer right here.
You need my glasses right here.
They do not like my family.
My family is not very hungry.
They hope I have my glasses.
Tell my family they are hungry.
Tell my family I am comfortable.
You hope my family is here.
My family is not going outside.
Tell my nurse I am not hungry.
I like how they tell it.
How do you do it right here?
I hope they need my faith.
You do not like my computer.
Tell my family I am not comfortable.
Tell my family they do not feel hungry.
They tell you I am comfortable.
I hope I do not need it.
No, I do not feel very comfortable.
Please tell my family I need my computer.
Yes, my nurse is coming here.
Tell my family I do not feel thirsty.
No, I do not feel comfortable.
I hope you do not need my family.
Tell my family they are thirsty.
Tell my family they are not comfortable.
No, my nurse is not coming here.
I like how comfortable my family is.
Tell my nurse I do not feel hungry.
